mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 75 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, under a new moon.

In city news, Verona is preparing for the Fall Partisan Primary and general election with various public notices now available. Also, please note that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, involving traffic shifts near the Highway PB intersection.

We have a great lineup ahead. Today, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch the free Concerts in the Park at Century School Park. Also happening today is Hop Haus Trivia. Looking further ahead, there is live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

The Verona Police Department reported a busy week. Notably, on August 5, officers located a man on Whalen Road who had a probation violation warrant; he fled briefly but was successfully taken into custody.
Today's flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
